mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fizz's attacks rend his target, dealing extra damage over time based on their missing health.
A cute little fish circles your champion - It may be attracting Sharks.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fizz's dexterity allows him to move through units and take less physical damage from basic attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fizz's dexterity allows him to move through units and take @DamageReductionCalc@ less damage from basic attacks.
For a short time, Fizz's attacks deal extra magic damage and apply grievous wounds to his target.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Fizz hops toward your cursor onto his spear, becoming untargetable, and then slams the ground dealing @EDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Reactivating this ability while Fizz is on top of his spear causes Fizz to jump again towards your cursor and deal @EDamage@ magic damage in a smaller area to enemies nearby, instead of slamming the ground.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fizz strikes his target and runs them through, dealing magic damage and applying on hit effects.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Fizz dashes through his target, dealing normal attack damage plus <magicDamage>@QDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. This ability can trigger on-hit effects.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fizz unleashes a magical fish that latches onto enemies or hovers over terrain, slowing champions if it is latched on to them. After a brief delay, a shark erupts from beneath the earth, dealing damage to enemies around the fish and knocking them aside.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Fizz releases a magical fish toward a location that can bind itself onto enemy champions, Slowing their movement by @SlowAmount*100@% by @SlowDuration@ seconds. If the fish misses an enemy champion, it will remain on the ground for a brief time, binding to any enemy champion walking over it.

After @DetonationTime@ seconds, a shark erupts from the earth, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage in a large area, Knocking Up the target the fish is attached to, Knocking other enemies aside and Slowing all enemies hit by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
For a short time, Fizz's attacks deal extra magic damage and apply grievous wounds to his target.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fizz's Trident causes rending wounds in his opponents, dealing magic damage to the target based on their missing health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Fizz's attacks rend his enemies, dealing @DoTDamage@ plus @MaxHealthScaling*100@% of the target's missing health as magic damage over @PassiveDoTDuration@ seconds. (Max @MaxMonsterDamage@ vs. minions).

Active: For @ActiveDuration@ seconds, Fizz's attacks deal an additional @ActiveDamage@ magic damage on hit and apply Grievous Wounds to his target, reducing incoming healing by @GrievousWounds*100@%.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <keyword>Grievous Wounds</keyword>: Reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.
